title: Computer Vision Model Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Detection, segmentation, tracking, depth estimation, and evaluation datasets. The Computer Vision Model Database documents how machines see: detection (what and where), segmentation (which pixels), tracking (across frames), depth estimation (how far), each with model records, training data descriptions, evaluation datasets, and measured performance. Vision models fail in specific ways — bad lighting, novel objects, adversarial patterns — so every record includes the failure modes alongside the mAP scores.

title: Computer Vision Model Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods, framings, and analyses developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout; never mixed with public-harvest records. Tasks and metrics. Detection: boxes + labels; mAP = mean average precision over classes at IoU thresholds. Segmentation: per-pixel labels; mean IoU. Tracking: identity across frames; MOTA (misses + false positives + ID switches). Depth: per-pixel distance; RMSE/relative error. Pose: keypoints; PCK. Architectures: CNN backbones, vision transformers, hybrid; real-time families (YOLO-style) vs accuracy families. Training: augmentation is critical (lighting, occlusion, scale); domain gap (synthetic vs real) measured, not assumed. Failure modes: illumination change, motion blur, occlusion, novel viewpoints, small objects, adversarial patches. Deployment: quantization (INT8, ~4x smaller, small accuracy cost), pruning, TensorRT/edge compilers; FPS measured on target hardware.

demo.title: Execution: A* pathfinding on a grid
demo.code: const grid=[[0,0,0,1],[0,1,0,0],[0,0,0,0]];const W=4,H=3;function h(a,b){return Math.abs(a[0]-b[0])+Math.abs(a[1]-b[1]);}function astar(s,g){const open=[{p:s,f:h(s,g),c:0}],came={},cost={[s]:0};while(open.length){open.sort((a,b)=>a.f-b.f);const cur=open.shift();if(cur.p[0]===g[0]&&cur.p[1]===g[1]){const path=[g];let k=g+'';while(came[k]){path.unshift(came[k]);k=came[k]+'';}return path;}for(const [dx,dy] of [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]){const n=[cur.p[0]+dx,cur.p[1]+dy];if(n[0]<0||n[1]<0||n[0]>=H||n[1]>=W||grid[n[0]][n[1]])continue;const nc=cur.c+1;if(cost[n+'']===undefined||nc<cost[n+'']){cost[n+'']=nc;came[n+'']=cur.p;open.push({p:n,f:nc+h(n,g),c:nc});}}}}const path=astar([0,0],[2,3]);J({steps:path.length-1});assert(path.length-1===5,'astar');
